newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Jones Medical buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jones Medical buy repeated.

text.p: - Everen Securities analyst Jeffrey Kraws said he repeated an outperform rating on Jones Medical Industries Inc stock based, in part, on revenues and profits the drug company is expected to generate as patients seeking treatment of thyroid problems switch to its drug.

- An article in the April 16 issue of the Journal of the American Medical Association shows that Jones Medical's treatment Levoxyl is bioequivalent to Knoll Pharmaceutical's Synthroid, Kraws said in a report. He estimates that for every $5 million in Levoxyl sales that switch from Synthroid, Jones Medical gains $0.05 a share in earnings. He added that he believes a large portion of the estimated five to eight million hypothyroid patients will switch to Jones Medical's product over time based on the clinical study results.
- Knoll Pharmaceutical is a unit of Germany's BASF AG.
- In the report, Kraws also estimates Jones Medical's 1997 earnings at $1.10 a share and 1998 earnings at $1.35. For the first quarter of 1997, he estimates earnings at $0.25-$0.26.
- Shares of Jones Medical rose 3/4 to 28-1/2.
